import sys

def main():
    s = sys.stdin.readline().strip()
    nbInsert = 0
    
    i = 0
    while i < len(s):
        count = 1
        while i + 1 < len(s) and s[i] == s[i + 1]:
            count += 1
            i += 1
        if count % 2 == 0:
            nbInsert += 1
        i += 1
    
    print(nbInsert)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
